### Love Bears and Believes
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/love-bears-and-believes
Passage: 1 Corinthians 13:7
Points:
- Genuine Christian love preserves community unity by refusing to let minor offenses destroy relationships.
- Bearing all things involves overlooking petty slights while still addressing grave sins when appropriate.
- Believing all things calls believers to avoid undue suspicion without falling into foolish naivete.
- Mature love patiently gives others room to grow in grace rather than demanding immediate perfection.

### Love Is Charming
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/love-is-charming
Passage: 1 Corinthians 13:4-5
Points:
- Jealousy and arrogance contradict godly love because both are consumed with self-interest.
- Boasting puffs up personal pride like a fireplace bellows and alienates the people around us.
- Biblical love manifests in tactful courtesy, demonstrating a gentle and delightful demeanor.
- People are drawn toward Christlikeness through winsome kindness rather than harsh demands or force.

### Don’t Let Grudges Hold You Hostage
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-april-27-2026.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 13:4-5
Points:
- Biblical love demonstrates mercy by actively choosing to overlook personal irritations and faults.
- Keeping a mental scorecard of wrongs harms relationships and traps people in past bitterness.
- Rudeness frequently occurs when individuals react out of unhealed wounds from earlier experiences.
- Releasing grudges instead of seeking revenge reflects the forgiving mercy of Jesus Christ.

### Choose Love over Knowledge
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-february-3-2023.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 13:1-3
Points:
- Love holds far greater eternal value than extensive knowledge or remarkable spiritual gifts.
- Having sufficient faith to move mountains profits nothing if the heart remains infected with malice.
- Outward sacrifices and good deeds lack spiritual worth when detached from divine love.
- Experiencing God's love should lead believers to actively extend kindness and encouragement to others.
